#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        int N = std::stoi(line);
        std::string line2;
        if (!std::getline(std::cin, line2)) break;
        const char* chars = line2.c_str();

        int maxWordLength = 0;
        int wordCount = 0;
        int currentWordLength = 0;
        int i = 0;

        while (i < N) {
            char c = chars[i];

            if (c != '_' && c != '(' && c != ')') {
                currentWordLength++;
            } else if (c == '_') {
                if (currentWordLength > maxWordLength) {
                    maxWordLength = currentWordLength;
                }
                currentWordLength = 0;
            } else if (c == '(') {
                if (currentWordLength > maxWordLength) {
                    maxWordLength = currentWordLength;
                }
                currentWordLength = 0;
                i++;
                while (i < N && chars[i] != ')' && chars[i] != '_') {
                    c = chars[i];
                    if (c != '_' && c != '(' && c != ')') {
                        currentWordLength++;
                    } else if (c == '_') {
                        if (currentWordLength != 0) {
                            wordCount++;
                            currentWordLength = 0;
                        }
                    } else if (c == ')') {
                        if (currentWordLength != 0) {
                            wordCount++;
                            currentWordLength = 0;
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                    i++;
                }
            }
            i++;
        }
        if (currentWordLength > maxWordLength) {
            maxWordLength = currentWordLength;
        }
        std::cout << maxWordLength << " " << wordCount << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
